subject: Request: brief audit-period affirmation for Borealis procurement
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <sam.lee@borealis.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@borealis.ai
Date: Sun, 1 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: brief audit-period affirmation for procurement review

Hi Ben,

Quick ask from our procurement team — we have a contract review next week and need a short, signed affirmation that bridges the gap between Redwood's SOC 2 Type II report period (report end date: 2027-06-30) and the present. The buyer is primarily concerned about whether there have been any material control changes, and a statement confirming that controls in scope remain in place since the report period end.

Can you provide a 1–2 page letter or a short PDF we can include in the package? If possible we'd like it by EOD Friday, 8/6. If you need to point us to an existing attestation or include additional evidence (SOC2 PDF / controls change log), please attach.

Thanks — Sam
Samantha Lee
Head of Procurement, Borealis Analytics
procurement@borealis.ai

Attachment: (requested) copy of Redwood SOC 2 Type II report (we will accept a PDF or link)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Lee <sam.lee@borealis.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Aug 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: brief audit-period affirmation for procurement review

Hi Samantha — thanks for the note. We can provide a short affirmation letter that confirms the report period and states whether there have been any material changes to controls in scope since 2027-06-30. I'll loop in Lauren and Neha from our compliance team to prepare and review the text.

A couple quick clarifying items to help us scope the letter:
- Do you need the letter signed by an executive (CISO/Head of Security) or is a compliance manager signature sufficient?
- Will the buyer accept the SOC 2 Type II PDF plus a one-paragraph bridge statement, or do they require a standalone letter on company letterhead?
- Any special procurement language / PO number we should reference?

If you can confirm those, we'll circulate a draft within 48 hours and provide a final signed PDF.

Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2027 09:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: Borealis - bridge affirmation draft (need review)

Folks — Borealis procurement asked for a short bridging affirmation to cover 2027-06-30 through the current date. They prefer a signed PDF by EOD 8/6 but said an attachment + paragraph is acceptable.

I've drafted a concise statement that:
- Restates the SOC 2 Type II report period ending 2027-06-30
- Confirms there have been no material changes to in-scope controls since that date (or notes listed non-material updates)
- Provides contact for compliance follow-ups

Draft is attached (bridge_letter_borealis_draft.docx). Can you please:
1) Confirm whether this should be signed by the Head of Security or Compliance (I recommend Head of Security for procurement comfort)
2) Review for accuracy on the controls point — we patched a few minor infra automation routines in July; these were scoped as non-material.

If you're both good, I'll finalize and send to Sam and procurement with the SOC2 PDF.

Thanks — Ben
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Lee <sam.lee@borealis.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 14:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: brief audit-period affirmation for procurement review

Samantha — apologies for the slight delay and thanks for your patience. Please find attached:
- Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_20270630.pdf (final report)
- bridge_letter_borealis_final_20270809.pdf (signed by Head of Security)

Summary in brief:
- Report period covered: through 2027-06-30 (SOC 2 Type II).
- Since 2027-06-30, Redwood has implemented minor automation updates to our deployment verification tooling in July 2027. Those changes were reviewed by our security and controls teams and classified as non-material to the SOC 2 in-scope control objectives.
- No material changes to in-scope controls have occurred since the report period end.

If the buyer requires additional evidence (control change logs, remediation tickets, or auditor contact), please let me know and we can provide a secure link or a redacted bundle. We're happy to join a quick call with procurement if they'd like to walk through anything live.

Best regards,

Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0123
